# couchbase-capella_cluster_express_scaling (Resource)

Manages express scaling on an existing Couchbase Capella cluster. Express scaling requires the Enterprise support plan. Enabling or disabling it starts a rebalance that can run for many hours on large clusters, so create and update wait for the change to finish, up to the configured timeouts. If a timeout is reached, the change carries on in Capella and the resource is saved with a warning. Destroying this resource only removes it from the Terraform state and leaves express scaling on the cluster unchanged.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_cluster_express_scaling" "example" {
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
  project_id      = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id      = "<cluster_id>"
  express_scaling = true

  timeouts {
    create = "4h"
    update = "4h"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `express_scaling` (Boolean) - Whether express scaling is enabled on the cluster. Set to `true` to enable it and `false` to disable it. Reads as `true` while express scaling is being enabled, and `false` while it is being disabled.
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `express_scaling_state` (String) - The express scaling status of the cluster: `enabled`, `enabling`, `disabled` or `disabling`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the change to finish when the resource is created. Defaults to `60m`.
- `update` (String) How long to wait for the change to finish when the resource is updated. Defaults to `60m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_cluster_express_scaling.example cluster_id=<cluster_id>,project_id=<project_id>,organization_id=<organization_id>
```
